import subprocess
import sys


def run_migrations() -> None:
    subprocess.run(["./manage.py", "migrate", "--noinput"], check=True)


def smoke_test() -> bool:
    """True when the staging smoke test passed."""
    result = subprocess.run(["./scripts/smoke.sh", "staging"])
    return result.returncode == 0


def main() -> int:
    run_migrations()
    if not smoke_test():
        print("smoke test failed; not releasing", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    subprocess.run(["./scripts/release.sh"], check=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
